content_blocks.label: clause_1._TESTAMENTARY_DISPOSITIONS
content_blocks.text: I hereby revoke all prior wills and codicils, and declare this to be my last will and testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: My estate, including all real and personal property, shall be distributed as follows:...

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EXECUTOR
